children: TORONTO, Sept. 16, 2026 /CNW/ -- SLGI Asset Management Inc. ("Sun Life Global Investments") announces the following regular cash distributions for the month ending September 30, 2026 in respect of the exchange-traded series of units of funds managed by Sun Life Global Investments ("ETF Series"), as set out in the table below. Unitholders of record on September 23, 2026 will receive cash distributions for the respective ETF Series payable on September 30, 2026.
The details of the cash distribution amounts per unit are as follows:

Sun Life Core Advantage Credit Private Pool – ETF Series
SLCA

SLSC

SLGC

The Sun Life Exchange-Traded Funds Distribution Reinvestment Plan ("DRIP") will automatically reinvest cash distributions into the ETF Series making the distribution. The distribution amounts indicated in the table above will be paid in cash unless the unitholder has enrolled in the applicable DRIP of the respective ETF Series. For more information on how to enroll in DRIP and other considerations, please see the simplified prospectus.

About Sun Life Global Investments

Sun Life Global Investments is a trade name of SLGI Asset Management Inc., Sun Life Assurance Company of Canada and Sun Life Financial Trust Inc., all of which are members of the Sun Life group of companies. Sun Life Global Investments offers Canadians diverse investment solutions, empowering them to pursue their financial goals at every life stage. Sun Life Global Investments brings together the strength of one of Canada's most trusted names in financial services, Sun Life, with world class asset managers from around the world to deliver a truly global investment platform. For more information, visit
About Sun Life

Sun Life is a leading international financial services organization providing asset management, wealth, insurance and health solutions to individual and institutional Clients. Sun Life has operations in a number of markets worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., the United Kingdom, Ireland, Hong Kong, the Philippines, Japan, Indonesia, India, China, Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia and Bermuda. As of June 30, 2026, Sun Life had total assets under management of $1.70 trillion. For more information, please visit
Sun Life Financial Inc. trades on the Toronto (TSX), New York (NYSE) and Philippine (PSE) stock exchanges under the ticker symbol SLF.
